sn35.116:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ diṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyanti vadāmi.
sn35.116:1.2: na ca panāhaṃ bhikkhave appatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassantakiriyaṃ vadāmīti.
sn35.116:1.3: idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
sn35.116:1.4: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi
